identifier.value: Norm Ai Legal & Compliance AI Platform

product.name: Norm Ai Legal & Compliance AI Platform
product.description: A platform that embeds laws, regulations, and firm policies into AI agents to automate legal and compliance workflows with explainable, reviewable outputs.

product.name: Norm Ai DDQ & RFP Completion
product.description: A solution that generates, verifies, reviews, and exports due-diligence questionnaires and requests for proposals using firm-approved content and cited sources.

product.name: Norm Law
product.description: An affiliated, AI-native law firm that provides legal services to institutional clients and encodes attorneys’ legal expertise into Norm Ai agents.

product.name: Norm Ai Legal AI Agents
product.description: Business-specific AI agents that apply encoded legal and compliance reasoning to automate high-stakes workflows while supporting human review and oversight.

product.name: Supervisory AI
product.description: A verification and oversight layer designed to check the outputs and operation of AI agents used in legal and compliance workflows.

product.name: Legal Engineering
product.description: A legal-technology implementation service that translates attorneys’ legal judgment, policies, and regulatory requirements into executable logic for AI agents.
